guarded-delete-before-eligibility.description: Irreversible rehome/move before a conditional delete that can no-op.

missing-contract-version-order.description: Consuming service lockfile/client bumped before published model jar.

sibling-shared-parent-omission.description: Partial leave treated as full dissolve on a shared parent.

auth-boundary-gap.description: Authorization missing or inconsistent on a customer-facing path.

async-side-effect-wrong-identity.description: Stop/start/notify uses wrong external identity or channel.

presence-shape-patch-mistake.description: PATCH/optional field presence mishandled (omit vs null vs value).

missing-rollback-or-deploy-order.description: Rollout/rollback or deploy order absent from a material change.

untestable-or-happy-path-only.description: Testing strategy covers only the happy path or is not testable.
